name: prior-indexed-context
description: Reuse specific evidenced knowledge and archive references without indexing or making the summary depend on them.
trap: Treats any prior index as permission to reference unrelated sources or initiates indexing to preserve the new handoff.

assertions.text: Uses the supplied prior-source evidence to include the relevant source label/query and confirmed archived session with project scope and a reason to retrieve each.
Omits the unrelated indexed label decision and keeps the accepted retry decision and next action understandable without Capy access.
Performs no discovery search merely to populate references and no direct or delegated indexing, fetch-and-index, import, reindex or archive; generated instructions request none.
Publishes the two named files to a new secret gist and returns its URL/prompt on successful writes without remote inspection.
Notes source availability limits and distinguishes prior archived evidence from current verification without changing the repository or running tests.
